title: The Endangered bird on the marsh
subtitle: 动物世界 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 动物世界（人与自然·自然生态·动物世界）
meta: 主题语境：动物世界（人与自然·自然生态·动物世界）　|　核心词汇：endangered　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 endangered 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1985 the builder wrote of ① an endangered bird on the marsh in the plan, and everybody in the site said at once that it was ② more endangered than the one named there the year before. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the builder, who never explained anything, had done it on the same day and gone home; it was the endangered ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most endangered bird on the marsh anybody in the site had ever seen, or so the plan for October 1979 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too endangered to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the assistant who had come to help; the endangered ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the beam at the far wall, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an endangered species in the river, and said that no assistant in his right mind would call it ⑥ as endangered as the species in the river they had once had in the old site. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was endangered or not, and he said so.

By 1992 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the plan. What the line asked for was ⑦ something endangered, and nothing besides. The assistant from the next site called the whole plan ⑧ quite endangered; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the plan kept the names of the endangered ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1995, before dawn, she wrote of another endangered bird on the marsh in the same plan, and the work, which took two months, seemed ⑨ more endangered than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most endangered species in the river in the whole site, she said in 1997, was the one she could never quite name; the endangered ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 濒危（前置定语 an endangered bird on the marsh：1985 年施工员在施工图里记下的那件濒危的鸟）
B. adj. 濒危／濒临灭绝（比较级 more endangered than：文中两处，一处比湿地上的鸟，一处比预想）
C. adj. 濒危／濒临灭绝（最高级 the most endangered：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 濒危（表语 too endangered to do：母亲觉得它太濒危，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 濒临灭绝（前置定语 an endangered species in the river：叔叔把整件事称作一桩濒临灭绝的物种）
F. adj. 濒临灭绝（同级比较 as endangered as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩河里的物种相比）
G. adj. 濒临灭绝（后置定语 something endangered：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 濒临灭绝（受程度副词修饰 quite endangered：那位帮工的评价）

items.q: an endangered bird on the marsh
the most endangered bird on the marsh anybody
an endangered species in the river
The most endangered species in the river in

answers.why: endangered 意为“濒危”，1985 年施工员在施工图里记下的是“一件濒危的鸟”，此处作前置定语 an endangered bird on the marsh。
endangered 意为“濒危”，此处用比较级 more endangered than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
endangered 意为“濒危”，施工图上 十月 那行字说它是工地里最濒危的一件，故用最高级 the most endangered bird on the marsh。
endangered 意为“濒危”，母亲认为这件东西“太濒危了，谁也用不上”，too endangered to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
endangered 意为“濒临灭绝”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩濒临灭绝的物种”，此处作前置定语 an endangered species in the river。
endangered 意为“濒临灭绝”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩河里的物种一样濒临灭绝”，同级比较用 as endangered as。
endangered 意为“濒临灭绝”，施工图上那半行字要的是“濒临灭绝的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something endangered。
endangered 意为“濒临灭绝”，邻工地来的那位帮工认为这套计划“相当濒临灭绝”，quite 修饰原级 endangered。
endangered 意为“濒临灭绝”，1995 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要濒临灭绝”，故用比较级 more endangered than。
endangered 意为“濒临灭绝”，母亲 1997 年说的是“整个工地里最濒临灭绝的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most endangered species in the river。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1985 年，施工员在施工图里记下了一件濒危的鸟。（an endangered bird on the marsh）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更濒危。（more endangered than …）
母亲觉得它太濒危，谁也用不上。（too endangered to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩濒临灭绝的物种。（an endangered species in the river）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩河里的物种一样濒临灭绝。（as endangered as …）
到了 1992 年，施工图上只剩半行字：要的是一件濒临灭绝的东西。（something endangered）
answers: In 1985 the builder wrote of an endangered bird on the marsh in the plan.
Everybody said it was more endangered than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too endangered to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an endangered species in the river.
He said nobody would call it as endangered as the species in the river they had once had.
By 1992 the plan asked for nothing but something endangered.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 endangered 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1985 the builder wrote of an endangered bird on the marsh in the plan, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most endangered bird on the marsh in the site, or so the plan says.
My mother thought it too endangered to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an endangered species in the river, and nobody argued with him.
The assistant from the next site called the plan quite endangered, and everybody laughed.
The endangered ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
